name: Gettin' Buzzed
summary: Berdun needs wild honey for the mead at the travel lodge, and asks you to gather it from wasp nests. He lends you a pellet gun to bring down the hives.

sections.title: Honey for Mead
sections.body: Berdun brews mead for the travel lodge, but he is too old to gather honey himself. You can find wasp nests in trees north of the Haldaar camp and west of Valormok. Hippogryphs mark the right place. Berdun lends you a pellet gun to knock down the hives and collect their honey.

faq.answer: Berdun needs wild honey for the mead he brews at the travel lodge.
The wasp nests are in trees north of the Haldaar camp and west of Valormok. If you see hippogryphs, you are in the right place.

faq.q: Why does Berdun need help gathering honey?
faq.answer: Berdun says he is getting on in years and cannot gather the honey himself.
Berdun lends you a pellet gun to knock down the hives.
Berdun uses honey to brew mead for the travel lodge.
